qualification.reason: The document is a Request for Quotes (RFQ) issued by the New York State Department of Taxation and Finance for GPS hardware and software, including submission deadlines, requirements, and evaluation criteria.

quotes.quote: REQUEST FOR QUOTES
BID DUE DATE: October 8, 2019
TITLE: GPS Hardware and Software
REQUEST FOR QUOTE NUMBER: 19-326
The New York State Department of Taxation and Finance (“DTF” or “Department”) has a need to monitor and manage a fleet of approximately ninety-three (93) vehicles.
Deadline for Submission of Quotes (Cover Page and Attachments 1-4) October 8, 2019 by 2:00 PM ET
The award will be made to the responsive and responsible Bidder who provides the lowest overall cost and meets all requirements set forth in this RFQ.

findings.title: Minimum Qualifications: Original Manufacturer or Authorized Reseller
findings.fact: The Bidder must be the original manufacturer or authorized reseller of the hardware and software to be provided.
findings.business_implication: Only manufacturers or authorized resellers can bid; resellers must provide proof of authorization.
findings.action_recommendation: Verify and document authorization status before bidding.

quotes.quote: The Bidder must: • Be the original manufacturer or authorized reseller of the hardware and software to be provided; and • Be compliant with all applicable laws and regulations related to providing these services.

findings.title: Compliance with Applicable Laws and Regulations
findings.fact: The Bidder must be compliant with all applicable laws and regulations related to providing these services.
findings.business_implication: Bidders must ensure they have all necessary licenses and permits.
findings.action_recommendation: Review and confirm compliance with all relevant laws and regulations.

quotes.quote: The Bidder must: • Be the original manufacturer or authorized reseller of the hardware and software to be provided; and • Be compliant with all applicable laws and regulations related to providing these services.

findings.title: Required Forms and Attachments
findings.fact: Bidders must submit the Cover Page, Attachment 1 (Quote Response Form), Attachment 2 (Offerer Understanding of, and Compliance with, Procurement Lobbying Guidelines), Attachment 3 (Offerer Disclosure of Prior Non-Responsibility Determinations), and Attachment 4 (Offerer's Certification of Compliance with State Finance Law 139-k (5)).
findings.business_implication: Incomplete submissions may be rejected.
findings.action_recommendation: Ensure all required forms are completed and included in the submission.

quotes.quote: Include the following completed forms in their submission: o Cover Page - Completed Cover Page of this RFQ o Attachment 1 - Quote Response Form o Attachment 2 - Offerer Understanding of, and Compliance with, Procurement Lobbying Guidelines o Attachment 3 - Offerer Disclosure of Prior Non-Responsibility Determinations o Attachment 4 - Offerer's Certification of Compliance with State Finance Law 139-k (5)

findings.title: Submission Method and Deadline
findings.fact: Responses must be emailed to BFS.Contracts@tax.ny.gov no later than October 8, 2019 at 2:00 PM ET. Responses received by other methods or after the deadline may not be accepted.
findings.business_implication: Late or incorrectly submitted bids may be disqualified.
findings.action_recommendation: Submit the bid via email before the deadline and confirm receipt.

quotes.quote: Responses to this RFQ must be emailed to BFS.Contracts@tax.ny.gov no later than October 8, 2019 at 2:00 PM ET. Responses received by other methods or after the deadline may not be accepted.

findings.title: Bid Due Date and Time
findings.fact: The deadline for submission of quotes is October 8, 2019 by 2:00 PM ET.
findings.business_implication: Bidders must ensure their submission is received by this deadline.
findings.action_recommendation: Plan to submit well before the deadline to avoid last-minute issues.

quotes.quote: Deadline for Submission of Quotes (Cover Page and Attachments 1-4) October 8, 2019 by 2:00 PM ET

findings.title: Award Based on Lowest Overall Cost
findings.fact: The award will be made to the responsive and responsible Bidder who provides the lowest overall cost and meets all requirements set forth in this RFQ.
findings.business_implication: Price is the primary factor, but compliance with all requirements is mandatory.
findings.action_recommendation: Ensure all requirements are met and provide competitive pricing.

quotes.quote: The award will be made to the responsive and responsible Bidder who provides the lowest overall cost and meets all requirements set forth in this RFQ.

findings.title: Term of Agreement
findings.fact: The Agreement will commence upon the issuance of a Purchase Order and shall be effective for a period of two (2) years.
findings.business_implication: Bidders must be prepared for a two-year commitment.
findings.action_recommendation: Consider pricing and service levels for the full term.

quotes.quote: TERM OF AGREEMENT: The Agreement will commence upon the issuance of a Purchase Order and shall be effective for a period of two (2) years.

findings.title: Electronic Payment Requirement
findings.fact: Payment for invoices submitted by the awarded Bidder shall only be rendered electronically unless payment by paper check is expressly authorized by the Commissioner, at the Commissioner’s sole discretion, due to extenuating circumstances.
findings.business_implication: Bidders must be set up for electronic payment through the State Comptroller's procedures.
findings.action_recommendation: Ensure compliance with electronic payment requirements and register with the Statewide Financial System.

quotes.quote: Payment for invoices submitted by the awarded Bidder shall only be rendered electronically unless payment by paper check is expressly authorized by the Commissioner, at the Commissioner’s sole discretion, due to extenuating circumstances.

findings.title: Procurement Lobbying Termination
findings.fact: DTF reserves the right to terminate this Agreement in the event it is found that the certification filed by the Offerer/bidder in accordance with New York State Finance Law §139-k was intentionally false or intentionally incomplete.
findings.business_implication: False certifications can lead to termination of the contract.
findings.action_recommendation: Ensure all certifications are accurate and truthful.

quotes.quote: DTF reserves the right to terminate this Agreement in the event it is found that the certification filed by the Offerer/bidder in accordance with New York State Finance Law §139-k was intentionally false or intentionally incomplete.

findings.title: Installation Completion Deadline
findings.fact: All installations must be completed no later than the end of Calendar Year 2019.
findings.business_implication: Bidders must have the capacity to install devices at three locations within a tight timeframe.
findings.action_recommendation: Plan installation schedule and resources accordingly.

quotes.quote: All installations must be completed no later than the end of Calendar Year 2019.

findings.title: Data Reliability Determination
findings.fact: The Department reserves the right, in its sole discretion, to make the final determination of whether the proposed solution includes information that is deemed reliable.
findings.business_implication: The Department has subjective authority to judge data reliability, which could affect acceptance.
findings.action_recommendation: Ensure the proposed solution provides reliable data and be prepared to demonstrate it.

quotes.quote: The Department reserves the right, in its sole discretion, to make the final determination of whether the proposed solution includes information that is deemed reliable.

findings.title: No Explicit Liability Cap or Indemnification Clause
findings.fact: The RFQ does not contain explicit liability cap or indemnification provisions beyond standard clauses.
findings.business_implication: Bidders may face unlimited liability if not addressed in the contract.
findings.action_recommendation: Seek clarification or negotiate liability terms during contract discussions.

findings.title: Fixed Pricing for Term
findings.fact: Prices as they appear on submitted bids must be guaranteed by the vendor for the term of the Agreement.
findings.business_implication: The bidder must commit to fixed pricing for the entire two-year term, which may pose financial risk if costs increase.
findings.action_recommendation: Ensure pricing strategy accounts for potential cost increases over the two-year term.

quotes.quote: Prices as they appear on submitted bids must be guaranteed by the vendor for the term of the Agreement.

findings.title: No Separate Travel Charges
findings.fact: Charges for travel cannot be listed as separate line items on the bid response form. The prices bid for each item must be inclusive of all costs.
findings.business_implication: The bidder must absorb all travel costs within the per-device pricing, potentially reducing profit margins.
findings.action_recommendation: Calculate travel costs carefully and incorporate them into the per-device prices.

quotes.quote: Charges for travel cannot be listed as separate line items on the bid response form. The prices bid for each item must be inclusive of all costs.

findings.title: No Additional Costs Beyond Bid
findings.fact: Invoices cannot reflect charges in excess of the totals bid on Attachment 1, Quote Response Form, unless the additionally incurred costs are mutually agreed upon in writing between the Bidder and an authorized Department representative.
findings.business_implication: The bidder cannot pass on any unanticipated costs without written agreement, limiting flexibility.
findings.action_recommendation: Ensure all potential costs are included in the initial bid to avoid disputes.

quotes.quote: Invoices cannot reflect charges in excess of the totals bid on Attachment 1, Quote Response Form, unless the additionally incurred costs are mutually agreed upon in writing between the Bidder and an authorized Department representative.

findings.business_implication: The bidder must be set up to receive electronic payments and comply with State Comptroller procedures.
findings.action_recommendation: Ensure the company is registered for electronic payment with the State Comptroller.

quotes.quote: Payment for invoices submitted by the awarded Bidder shall only be rendered electronically unless payment by paper check is expressly authorized by the Commissioner, at the Commissioner’s sole discretion, due to extenuating circumstances.

findings.title: No Payment for Unreceived Goods/Services
findings.fact: The Department will not pay any costs associated with goods or services that have not been received.
findings.business_implication: The bidder must deliver goods and services before receiving payment, impacting cash flow.
findings.action_recommendation: Plan for potential cash flow gaps and ensure timely delivery.

quotes.quote: The Department will not pay any costs associated with goods or services that have not been received.

findings.business_implication: The bidder must offer the lowest total cost to win, which may pressure margins.
findings.action_recommendation: Optimize pricing to be competitive while ensuring all requirements are met.

findings.title: Potential Conflict: Appendix B Informational vs. Requirements

findings.action_recommendation: Clarify with the Department whether Appendix B specifications are mandatory or merely informational.

quotes.quote: NOTE: Appendix B is provided for informational purposes to assist Bidders in understanding the Department’s current usage/capabilities and IS NOT incorporated as requirements in this RFQ.
